subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the parenthesis. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: Success has been man's greatest (a) motivate. It is very (b) importance for all. Success has a great effect on life. It brings pleasure and pride. It gives a sense of (c) fulfill. It means all-around (d) develop. Everybody hopes to be (e) success in life. But success smiles on those who have a proper approach, (f) plan, vision and stamina. One cannot be successful without (g) cultivate these certain basic things in life. It is very difficult to set out on a journey without (h) know one's goals and purposes. Clarity of the (i) object is a must to succeed in life. Focused approach with proper planning is certain to bring success. (j) decision and insincerity are big obstacles on the path to success.
guide_solution: (a) motivation (b) important (c) fulfillment (d) development (e) successful (f) planning (g) cultivating (h) knowing (i) objective (j) Indecision
